blindness_statement: Read only AGENTS, blind packet and allowlisted original textbook/syllabus PDFs. No PRIVATE drafts, labels, proposed keys, oracle, explanation/custody/coordinator/root derivations viewed. PDF skill instructions and runtime dependency metadata were consulted for extraction tooling only.
key_indexing: 1-based option positions; proposed_keys are independently supported candidates, [] means no determinate supported key, multiple keys indicate ambiguity. unique_answer is item-as-delivered judgment; a broader-corroborated candidate may coexist with false uniqueness when the item passage is absent.
source_evidence_definition: source_evidence_sufficient means supplied case-local excerpt/passage supports actual key and decisive exclusions, not merely that full textbook can supply missing premises. broader_original_source_support includes other complete narrative text in the same blind packet where explicitly stated.
